instant-chords.alt: A stone falls s(t) = 16t squared feet. Lines join the point (1, 16) on the curve to points at t = 2, 1.5 and 1.2, with slopes 48, 40 and 35.2; a dashed line through (1, 16) has slope 32. A table lists the average speeds from t = 1 over [1, 2], [1, 1.5], [1, 1.2], [1, 1.1], [1, 1.01] and [1, 1.001]: 48, 40, 35.2, 33.6, 32.16 and 32.016 feet per second, closing in on 32.
